agent.name: Character growth
agent.description: Now and then asks whether the story has changed the character or shown something new about them, and proposes one block of the character's living portrait (written like the card's own text) for the card's Memory tab. Nothing is used until you accept it.
agent.author: Molfar

fast.hint: writes a short paragraph as JSON; a stronger model gives better blocks
